review_candidates.title: Field Service Engineer
review_candidates.description: Are you someone who thrives on helping others? Enjoys solving challenging technical problems? Is passionate about working hands-on with computer hardware? Then you may be interested in the Field Service Engineer (FSE) position that we have available. It's an opportunity to join a team that meets the 24/7 data center maintenance needs of local customers with a focus on delivering exceptional service with each interaction. You will provide onsite system diagnostic and analysis support to customers within a geographical territory, or assigned to a specific account, supporting the customer per the terms of the Service Level Agreement (SLA) with Park Place Technologies. Specifically, it will be responding to customers' system failures by way of computer hardware service, testing, diagnostic analysis, and systems analysis of hardware, storage area networks, and system configurations. This role requires driving to different customer sites within a 120-mile radius for assigned service calls. You will use your own vehicle and be reimbursed for travel expenses. You will work Monday-Friday, 8am-5pm and also must be willing to participate in after-hours, on-call rotation responding to customer issues and servicing all equipment regardless of product training within the designated service area. What You'll Be Doing Customer Support Ensure timely, professional and effective response to customer service needs to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction Provide effective problem analysis and identification remotely before arrival at customer site; determine needed parts and documentation to minimize down time and multiple trips Perform service in a cost-effective manner, displaying professional attitude and courtesy while on site Maintain effective communication with customer and our customer support center during repair process and any projected delay Analyze software and hardware error logs, utilizing diagnostic and troubleshooting techniques and operating system analysis to ensure timely and effective repair Analyze, diagnose, troubleshoot and repair data center hardware (including mid- to high-end servers and storage devices) as well as storage area network and systems configuration and compatibility problems Utilize multiple tools for remote system connection to perform remote diagnosis, repair or configuration changes Follow customer specific repair procedures; assess current and future customer needs based on usage of the system Inventory/Parts Management Determine needed parts and quantities based on contracts in service area Return bad or excess parts in a timely manner Manage accurate inventory count (daily and as required) and perform bi-yearly physical count inventory Administrative Accurately complete and timely return audit forms, email replies, timesheets and expense reports Attend and participate in regularly scheduled team meetings Account for all activities correctly using Field Point time reporting utility What We're Looking For Experience working with OEM data center hardware with ability to grasp new products/concepts Successful prior field experience Strong troubleshooting skills; CompTia A+ and Server + preferred Availability for after hours, on-call rotation to support customer needs Must possess a valid driver’s license and an appropriate driving record based on the position travel requirements Ability to lift up to 50 pounds, stand and walk for extended periods of time, pull, lift, squat, reach, bend, and stoop to equipment, parts, and supplies. This is an active position that requires walking, standing, squatting, bending, and driving for over 50% of the workday. Potential requirement for work at height, including the use of ladders Must be able to pass customer background screenings in addition to Park Place Technologies pre-employment screening Bonus Points Certification and other OEM computer hardware certifications from major vendors such as Dell, IBM, HP, etc. are helpful Bachelor's degree in related field (i.e. Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent experience preferred Education High School Degree required Travel Must be able to travel to client sites up to 75% of the time within a predetermined territory radius (up to 4+ hours/one way by car)

review_candidates.title: Facility Management Director
review_candidates.description: The Facility Management Director is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic direction, governance, and performance of all hard services across the company’s real estate portfolio. This includes Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing (MEP), civil works, utilities, energy systems, and building fabric. The role ensures that all assets operate safely, efficiently, sustainably, and in full compliance with regulatory and operational standards. Reporting to the Operations Senior Director, the Director drives operational excellence, lifecycle asset optimization, cost efficiency, and continuous improvement across the FM hard services function. Job Responsibilities: Define and lead the hard services strategy across the FM arm, ensuring alignment with operational objectives, asset lifecycle plans, and long-term value creation. Oversee the performance, reliability, and compliance of all MEP systems, civil assets, utilities, and infrastructure across the real estate portfolio. Establish and enforce hard services governance frameworks, technical standards, policies, and procedures to ensure consistency, safety, and quality. Own the hard services operating model, including preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance strategies to optimize system uptime and asset longevity. Lead Opex and Capex planning for hard services, ensuring effective budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and investment prioritization. Drive energy efficiency, sustainability, and ESG-related initiatives in coordination with relevant stakeholders, including utilities optimization and automation. Oversee vendor, contractor, and service provider performance, ensuring compliance with SLAs, contractual obligations, and risk management requirements. Partner with development, projects, and handover teams to ensure smooth transition of assets from construction to operations and readiness for occupancy. Act as the executive escalation point for critical technical incidents, system failures, and operational risks, ensuring timely and effective resolution. Develop and lead senior technical leadership teams, ensuring capability building, succession planning, and high-performance culture within hard services. Monitor regulatory changes, industry best practices, and emerging technologies to continuously enhance FM hard services delivery. In addition to any other tasks assigned by the direct manager Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Minimum 5 years in a leadership role of progressive experience in facilities management, hard services, or building services within large-scale real estate portfolios. Proven experience managing multi-site assets, large teams, and multiple service providers in mixed-use, commercial, or residential environments. Expert-level technical knowledge of MEP systems, civil assets, utilities, building automation, and relevant regulatory standards. Strong strategic, financial, and operational leadership capabilities with full accountability for hard services performance. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills. Proven ability to lead transformation, optimize asset performance, and drive continuous improvement at scale.

review_candidates.description: Job Summary: We are looking for an experienced Electrical Site Manager to lead and supervise electrical construction activities for HV/MV substations and energy infrastructure projects . The role will be responsible for ensuring that site activities are executed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved designs, specifications, quality standards, and project schedules. Key Responsibilities: Lead site planning and mobilization for the electrical scope, reviewing contract documents, execution/mobilization plans, PQP, HSE plans, and manpower/equipment utilization to ensure site readiness. Coordinate pre-execution readiness through detailed schedules and two-week look-ahead plans; verify availability of drawings, materials, manpower, subcontractors, and tools/equipment, and close readiness gaps. Approve site operational requests (DCMR, ACCR, ETR, SFR, vehicles/safety, subcontractor approvals) within delegated limits; coordinate with support departments for timely provision. Oversee implementation of method statements, ITPs, and safe systems of work; approve SNAs and work permits; ensure compliance with HSE and quality controls prior to execution. Manage daily/weekly coordination and progress meetings with PM, TO, Construction, and QC; issue minutes, track decisions, and communicate risks and recovery plans to stakeholders. Control materials flow with TO, MC, and QC, including MIR approvals, IMR/SCIMR endorsement, MSR/SSR, SMH, and storage/handling compliance as per project procedures. Lead subcontractor performance management, ensuring scope compliance, Workfront allocation, progress verification, monthly evaluations, and payment approvals. Coordinate Technical Office deliverables including PRs/SCRs, shop/as-built drawings, variation inputs, subcontractor payments, and client invoices. Manage and supervise testing and commissioning activities, witnessing FATs/SATs, validating pre-commissioning readiness, and ensuring system energization approvals. Monitor site productivity, resource utilization, and cost exposure; approve site overtime, purchases, and time sheets to maintain cost and efficiency targets. Coordinate delay and claim documentation with PM, Planner, and Contracts; record inspection delays, instructions, stoppages, and dependencies with supporting evidence. Lead construction close-out, including snag list rectification, completion notifications, lessons learned, and final documentation/records retention in line with ISO requirements. Ensure compliance with the company’s Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) policies, procedures, and regulations to maintain a safe working environment and prevent incidents or injuries. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (or equivalent). Post‑graduate project/construction management credential (e.g., PMP or equivalent); HV safety and protection/testing certifications. 10–12 years of experience in a managerial position within the same field. review_candidates.title: Electrical BIM Coordinator - ELV/Security Systems
review_candidates.description: Due to the continuing success and growth of our AESG team, a fantastic opportunity has opened up at our award-winning Specialist Consultancy, Engineering and Advisory Firm. We are headquartered in London, Riyadh, Singapore and Dubai, Cape Town, Cairo & Sydney working throughout the Middle East, Europe and Asia. Our areas of expertise are represented in four core verticals: Building Engineering, Planning and Infrastructure, Strategy and Advisory and Commissioning, Handover and Asset Management. We pride ourselves in being leaders in the industry in each of the services that we offer. We have one of the largest dedicated team with decades of cumulative experience in sustainable design, fire and life safety, cost management, façade engineering, commissioning, building performance, waste management, environmental consultancy, carbon management and acoustics. Job Purpose The primary role of the Electrical / ELV / Security BIM Coordinator shall be to develop, manage, and coordinate high-quality 3D BIM models for Electrical, Extra Low Voltage (ELV) Electronic and Physical Security systems throughout the full project lifecycle. The role shall support the design process by producing accurate BIM models, drawings, and documentation that comply with project requirements, industry standards, and regulatory codes. The role is expected to provide technical direction to the security design team on all BIM related matters, developing technical competence and ensuring consistent application of relevant standards, best practices, and project requirements. In addition, the role will serve as the primary point of contact for all security related BIM matters, providing expert guidance on technical queries, coordination challenges, and modelling issues. This includes liaising with internal stakeholders and project teams to ensure timely resolution of BIM-related concerns and effective integration of security systems across disciplines. Qualification / Experience Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in BIM, specifically in Electrical/ELV/Security systems. 3-5 years of experience in BIM coordination. Strong experience with Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, and AutoCAD MEP. Sound understanding of BIM Execution Plans (BEP), Level of Development (LOD), and project delivery standards. Experience working on large-scale, multi-disciplinary construction projects. GENERAL EXPECTANCY The BIM Coordinator is expected to consistently deliver accurate, reliable, and well-coordinated BIM models that support the successful planning, design, and execution of complex security projects. The role requires a strong commitment to quality, technical excellence, and compliance with company standards, industry regulations, and project-specific requirements. The individual is expected to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams, contributing proactively to coordination efforts and resolving design and constructability challenges through effective use of BIM processes and digital tools. Maintaining model integrity throughout the project lifecycle is essential, as is the ability to adapt to evolving design requirements and managing priorities across multiple projects. Responsibilities Develop, manage, and coordinate 3D BIM models for security systems (Electronic/Physical). Lead clash detection and coordination processes using Autodesk Revit, Navisworks, ACC/ BIM 360 and other BIM tools. Provide technical support and mentorship to the security design team in BIM. Ensure designs comply with project requirements, standards, and codes. Collaborate with architects, structural engineers, and other discipline BIM leads to ensure overall project coordination. Act as the primary point of contact for security-related BIM queries and issues. Facilitate coordination meetings, resolving design conflicts and model discrepancies. Review models for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project BIM requirements. Implement and enforce BIM standards, workflows, and best practices. Conduct regular audits on BIM models Generate detailed coordination reports, clash reports, and model status updates. Support the BIM Manager in preparing BEP and Weekly progress BIM reports. COMPETENCIES Leadership / Management skills Guide and support the security design team members to achieve technical competence in BIM.
